items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: Oh, we played together pretty good wives in the brass band

ctx.x: Not in the string band? No. Can't tell that a lot. Oh, indeed. About how long did you play together in the brass band?
Oh, we played together pretty good wives in the brass band, but seven or eight children.
That was down in the country, down at the Deer Range. That's right. You got that right.
